title: Portfolio register row
description: A portfolio view of a hierarchy entry (L0 DOM, L1 LFC, L2 JRN). Inside a journey system it mirrors journey-registry for parent_id, level, actor_id, state and status, and links only opportunities and initiatives of its own journeys. metric_coverage is the share of stage-level nodes with at least one metric, a decimal from 0 to 1 with up to two decimals. One CSV row is one JSON object keyed by column header; an empty cell means 'not yet known' and is omitted from the object, so 'required' means the cell must be filled. List-valued cells hold IDs separated by ';' with no spaces. Required: journey_id, level and name (identity), state and status (lifecycle), evidence_freshness (the portfolio exists to show freshness; use 'unknown' when not assessed). parent_id and actor_id follow the journey registry; owner, coverage, links and review date may be pending.

parent_id.description: Hierarchy entry one or more levels up (DOM or LFC).

metric_coverage.description: Share of stage-level nodes with at least one metric: 0 to 1, up to two decimals; empty when the journey has no stages.

linked_opportunities.description: Opportunity IDs (OPP) of this entry's journeys, ';'-separated.

linked_initiatives.description: Initiative IDs (INI) addressing this entry's opportunities, ';'-separated.
